headline: Liverpool's Andoni Iraola: Newcastle draw a 'good step' for Alexander Isak
description: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola has described Alexander Isak's performance against Newcastle United as a "good step," despite the forward failing to get on the scoresheet in Sunday's 2-2 draw at St. James' Park.

headline: Newcastle boss Jaissle: 'Careful' to avoid being fined after 'really soft' penalty vs. Liverpool
description: Newcastle United head coach Matthias Jaissle said he had to be careful "not to get fined" after the "really soft" late penalty awarded to Liverpool in Sunday's 2-2 draw at St James' Park.

headline: Maresca: Man City 'need different solutions' after playing Guéhi in midfield vs. Bournemouth
description: Enzo Maresca has said Manchester City "need different solutions" after playing Marc Guéhi in midfield against Bournemouth on Sunday.

headline: New season, same Liverpool: More work ahead to be Premier League contender again
description: Liverpool changed coaches after last season's poor showing, but the Reds' Premier League opener looked like more of the same.
